lens: Skeptic. Fabrics were compared at matched physical scale, using a 0.43 m seat width as the ruler: e4 x0.64 against y_47306 x0.85/x0.45/x1.0, q15 x0.6 against y_47300 x1.0, and q16 x0.82 against y_47301. Measured: box mean, B/R, luminance p10/p50/p90, and high-pass column/row CV. Official photos decide colour; in-flight photos decide geometry (no new downloads). The candidate is c4 (uncommitted working tree). Scratch files are in /tmp/claude-0/rater15A/ (st.py, st2.py, fab_cmp.png, studio.png, q15top.png).

issues.title: Petal fleck reads as white leopard spots (round, dense, dark-haloed) instead of sparse light-blue petals
issues.evidence: fab_cmp.png pair 4. e4 pad x0.64: B/R 1.90, p90/p50 2.15. y_47306 pad x0.85: B/R 2.32, p90/p50 1.67. q16 near crown x0.82: p90/p50 2.41 vs y_47301 1.92. Visible on the q16 near seats and the q15 seat-4 pads.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: re-cut from a region of y_47300 / y_47306 where the flecks are small (the y_47306 centre pad). Or, if the tile is upscaled from a far crop, cut it at the native scale: the flecks should be ~3-5 mm petals at ~30 % coverage, not ~8 mm dots at ~45 %. Remove the dark halo (an unsharp or contrast artefact). Tint the flecks toward #9fb0e0 and drop their lift ~20 %. Targets: pad p90/p50 ~1.7, B/R >= 2.2.

issues.title: Tick columns still soften at row distance
issues.evidence: q15 seats 1/3 x0.6: colCV 0.086, p10/p50 0.68, p90/p50 1.41. y_47300 seats 1/3: colCV 0.162/0.206, p10/p50 0.44, 1.53. Close up, colCV 0.162 against the photo's 0.082 is fine, so the loss is in mip / LOD filtering.
issues.fix: For the tick layer only: bias the mip LOD ~-0.5, or add a low-frequency column-darkening term (a ~4.5 mm dark channel) to the far-LOD / mip levels so the channel survives minification. Optionally darken the tick tile channels ~15 %. Target q15 colCV >= 0.13, p10/p50 <= 0.55.

issues.title: Hero-row fabric mix differs from y_47300 (seat 2 is mosaic, should be fleck)
issues.evidence: q15 front row: tick / mosaic (diamond pads) / tick / fleck. y_47300: tick / fleck / tick / fleck. Seat 2 q15: B/R 2.13, p90/p50 1.32. y_47300 seat 2: B/R 2.24, p90/p50 1.92.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js or the fabric cycle in 09_seats.js: make the q15 hero row tick / fleck / tick / fleck, keeping mosaic and diamond for other rows (the 6-cycle can stay, phase-shifted).

issues.title: Armrest reads as an open bracket truss, not a closed J sweep
issues.evidence: e7: a post plus a diagonal strut under a white box pad. y_47303: one smooth closed light-grey J moulding from under the pan rising to the pad, with no visible strut.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: replace the post and diagonal with one swept closed profile (~4 cm wide, 2.5 cm deep) along a J path (from the rear pan rail, forward and up to the pad front), and fill the gap under the pad. Colour light grey (#cfd2d6, not white).

issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: inset the shell side ~2 cm behind the fabric roll at back height, or extend the fabric side roll 2 cm.
